topic: Root-crate peels: index-cluster extraction + interlock decoupling (continuation of build-cycle-levers item 3)
notes:
Carved from thread-9938dffd after items 1+2 closed and the mechanization landed. State at handoff (2026-06-10, root crate 160.9k LOC / 250 files, all measurements via inline crate:: ref scan — NOT use-statement counts, which understate):

TOOLING IN PLACE: `extract_rust_crate` bbox_refactor_run compound (commit c8ff47f, runbook sm-refactor-rust) mechanizes leaf peels: scaffold w/ dep inference + alias swap + members merge, rust_workspace_dag_check guard, cargo check --workspace + compile-fix, rollback. Its preflight refuses non-leaf modules listing crate::<other> offenders file:line — use that refusal as the coupling survey for any candidate. Prior art: bbox-packets peel (a0217f5), bbox-system-memory + query/template/search→corpus-core (3f93525). Known hazards (all hit in practice): cross-crate cfg(test) inversion (leaf #[cfg(test)] helpers configured out in consumer test builds — expose un-gated *_from(&dir) fns, consumer owns repo-root fixture paths), env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR) re-rooting, mixed grouped use imports, empty source dir left after move.

NEXT CANDIDATE — index cluster: transcripts/ now depends ONLY on index/ (Provider phantom edge severed, 4e15de3; index/ also has zero orchestration refs). A combined cut (index 8.7k + transcripts 2.7k + code_nav residue 0.7k) is bounded by index/'s remaining root-module deps: knowledge, projects, threads, roadmap, edge_index, store_persister + the corpus-core aliases (entity_ref, chunker, git, query already crates). Work shape: per-family classification of index/'s deps — which are type-only (move types down to corpus-core), which invertible (callbacks/traits), which genuinely bind (then the cluster boundary grows or waits).

DEFERRED / REAL COUPLING (design-level, not peels): embed/ (orchestration AgentManifest/AgentRef types ×5 + index ×12 + artifacts ×9), providers/ (brofile listing + task_result_json), council/ (allocator/dispatch_prelude/team + server state — it IS orchestration). The big interlock: tools/ 29.9k (39 deps) + server/ 11.1k (28) + orchestration/ 28.9k (8 out / 45 in) + workflow/ 13.5k ≈ 83k of top-of-graph integration — dependency inversion design work, not mechanical cuts.

Build-cycle context for payoff accounting: root-edit check 3.3s, blackboxd rebuild ~31s, workspace test gate 24s — peels mainly buy smaller serial tail + cheaper relink + honest boundaries now, extraction-readiness later.

Picked up in new session (2026-06-10, beta/blackbox-v2). Starting with the index-cluster candidate: per-family classification of index/'s root-module deps via extract_rust_crate preflight refusal as coupling survey.

Index-cluster classification DONE + persistence-floor peel SHIPPED (2 commits on beta/blackbox-v2). Root crate 160.9k→158.1k LOC, 250→248 files.

SHIPPED: (1) edge_index.rs split — store-agnostic sidecar layer (Edge type, lane dir helpers, JSONL append/replace/merge/purge/compact, legacy compaction) extracted to root module edge_sidecar.rs (4,095→3,301 + 846); emitters (EdgeIndex, EdgeStoreRefs, thread_edge_kind_name) stay; edge_index glob-re-exports edge_sidecar so zero caller rewrites. (2) NEW CRATE bbox-edge-sidecar = manifest (775, pure leaf) + snapshot (1,219) + edge_sidecar; deps only bbox-chunker + bbox-corpus-core; root use-swaps keep all crate:: paths resolving. append_project_edges un-gated (#[cfg(test)] doesn't cross crates — the predicted hazard, hit and handled). Gates: workspace check+tests clean, nextest mid 3721 + full 3723 pass, clippy clean.

OPERATIONAL: extract_rust_crate compound (c8ff47f) NOT available via MCP — running prod daemon predates it; peel was hand-rolled with supported primitives (extract_rust_items + write_file + git mv + sed alias swaps). Redeploy prod blackboxd to use the compound next time.

CLASSIFICATION RESULT (index/ + transcripts/ out-of-cluster deps, prod-only, test refs excluded):
- SOLVED/type-only: projects (ProjectRecord already corpus-core; only ProjectRegistry::load_records — thin static JSON reader, trivial move-down to corpus-core::project_record), util::now_iso (already corpus-core re-export), manifest/snapshot/edge-sidecar I/O (now peeled).
- NEAR-LEAF remaining: store_persister (299 ln; deps json_store✓ + util::BlockingScope) → corpus-core candidate; BlockingScope (15-ln tokio-debug-assert marker in util.rs:624) must move down first (needs minimal tokio rt dep in corpus-core — mild design call).
- GENUINELY BINDING (inversion design needed, NOT mechanical): index engine calls doc builders directly (writer_actor applies knowledge/roadmap/thread upserts; reindex.rs runs reindex_*_store_standalone; IndexOp enum CARRIES store types KnowledgeEntry/RoadmapItem/Thread). Inverting = doc-builder registry trait or store-types-down split of knowledge.rs(4.4k, blocked by render×7)/threads(1.7k, blocked by embed_queue×7)/roadmap(1.2k, nearly free)/notes(1.1k, embed_queue×2). embed_queue itself is top-of-graph (server/embed/vectors) — index's 2 enqueue calls + 1 id-helper are callback-invertible.
- NEXT MECHANICAL: store_persister+BlockingScope→corpus-core; ProjectRegistry::load_records→corpus-core. NEXT DESIGN: doc-builder/IndexOp inversion to unblock the index+transcripts crate peel (~11.4k).

THE INDEX-CLUSTER PEEL SHIPPED — the "design-shaped" inversion was executed, not deferred. 4 more commits on beta/blackbox-v2. Root crate 158.1k→149.0k LOC (160.9k at arc start), 248→236 files.

INVERSION (Phase 1, in place): (1) corpus-core gains load_project_records (thin projects.json read); engine passes consume it, not ProjectRegistry. (2) index/embed_hook.rs — startup-injected daemon hooks (git::set_notes_namespace pattern): embed enqueue (project_file/git_message) + the manual-rebuild store-doc pass; engine emits no-op when unregistered. project_file_entity_id* moved here from embed_queue. (3) build_index's inline knowledge_docs call → injected store pass (single writer/commit preserved). (4) TranscriptIndex::spawn_writer_actor → IndexWriterActor::spawn_for (root-side), the single attach point calling register_index_store_hooks(). (5) Store-coupled tests relocated to src/index/store_integration_tests.rs; registry-writing tests now write projects.json directly via corpus-core id fns.

PEEL (Phase 2): crates/bbox-corpus-index = engine (mod core, search, passes [split from reindex.rs], project_files, git_history, tool_edges, helpers, embed_hook, code_tokenizer) + transcripts/. Root src/index/ is a facade (pub use bbox_corpus_index::index::*) + daemon layers: doc builders, writer_actor, reindex orchestration. IndexWriteOp still carries store types — BY DESIGN, it lives daemon-side now; no registry-trait ceremony was needed once the cut went UNDER the writer actor instead of over it.

HAZARDS HIT (all from the known list): cfg(test) cross-crate ×2 (reader_reload_for_test un-gated; append_project_edges earlier), env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR) re-rooting (repo-indexing slow test → ancestors().nth(2)), rmcp::schemars → schemars 1.2 direct (rmcp's bundled version; root's 0.8 line is a different legacy dep), `use bbox_chunker::{self as chunker, ...}` for bare-alias call sites.

GATES: workspace check+tests 0 warnings, nextest mid 3721 + full 3723 (quarantine filter is name-based, survived the package move), clippy 0, lint-concurrency ok, isolated blackboxd boot smoke on :7299 ok.

REMAINING (small, mechanical): store_persister+BlockingScope→corpus-core (still optional; writer_actor stayed root so nothing blocks on it). Workspace now: corpus-core ← chunker/edge-sidecar ← corpus-index ← blackbox. Remaining root fat is the known orchestration/tools/server interlock (~83k), a different arc.

Resolved by operator decision: root-crate peel campaign has gone as far as it can for now — index-cluster extraction + interlock decoupling peeled to their practical limit. Reopen or spawn a new thread if a future campaign resumes the peels.
